correctness.rationale: The coordinate decomposition gives colon ideals and prime submodules explicitly. From these, full-spectrum closed sets are determined exactly by the coordinates that are full, so adjacency becomes support disjointness. Distinct support cells have distinct neighborhoods, the quotient disjointness graph has automorphism group induced by coordinate permutations, and codimension-one support-cell sizes recover each proper-subspace count. Exhaustive small examples verify the definitions directly; the general proof does not depend on enumeration.
